name: mirage
text: Got it, your v1.0.129 report is in. Cold start was 8.8 s (it was 10-18 s before). The cause is the app building its parts and loading its stores before the first screen. The biggest one is bets.json, still 8 MB, loaded and rewritten whole. The report has no per-stage times yet (only 'ended after 1125 s'), so next I'm making the bets store load after the first screen and adding the stage timings. That goes in the next release.
